spot.raw_capture_limitations: Hashes cover the exact JSON response text returned by web retrieval, not original HTTP wire bytes or headers. Kraken supplied no provider event timestamp.

spot_order_book.coverage: Coinbase, OKX, Kraken, Bitstamp, Bitfinex and Gemini; Binance and Bitget excluded.
caveats: Resting orders can be cancelled or moved.
Snapshot is 48 minutes before the latest OKX quote and not synchronized to the post-CPI market.
Displayed depth is not executed volume or guaranteed fillable liquidity.

market.derivatives_interpretation: Long-heavy positioning and long-side deleveraging are common descriptive findings. The OI range ($1.21B-$1.64B) reflects non-identical venue coverage; aggregators are not independent source groups. No average is calculated and no direction is inferred.

caveats: Includes cold/custody wallets and wrapped-token reserves.
Newly labeled wallets distort naive totals.
Tracked exchange balances are not tradable float or proof of net customer deposits/withdrawals.
Tracker data derive from overlapping issuer files; not independent confirmations.
Holdings changes do not prove spot-market sales; cash versus in-kind redemption and custody transfers unresolved.
Missing fund reports are null, not zero.

cpi.reason: BLS did not collect October 2025 survey data because of the lapse in appropriations, so the comparison base is unavailable.
cpi.interpretation: Headline and core monthly CPI each exceeded Reuters consensus by 0.1 percentage point. Reuters reported that markets had fully priced a 25bp December Fed hike early Tuesday. This is a macro event feature, not an XRP directional signal.

circle_binance.caveat: Direct Circle equity investment by Binance and commercial USDC distribution relationship; not evidence of XRP investment or demand.

coinbase_xrp_collateral.coinbase_role: Interface to Morpho; not the lender or collateral owner in the underlying protocol.
coinbase_xrp_collateral.geography: US excluding New York; limited UK/Canada access; asset/rate availability varies.
coinbase_xrp_collateral.caveat: XRP-backed USDC borrowing is a verified collateral utility path on Base, not native XRPL lending or proof of net XRP purchases.
